# Kimi K3 quickstart

Kimi K3 holds a 1.05M-token context window.

The model ID is `moonshotai/Kimi-K3`. Pricing is $3.00 per 1M input tokens, $15.00 per 1M output tokens.

K3 accepts up to 1.05M input tokens on Together, and context caching is automatic.

| Parameter | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `max_tokens` | No ceiling below the 1.05M context limit. Cap it yourself for short answers. |
